steps.code:
import math

rainfall = {
    "January": 88,
    "February": 71,
    "March": 57,
    "April": 55,
    "May": 49,
    "June": 38,
    "July": 29,
    "August": 41,
    "September": 66,
    "October": 92,
    "November": 97,
    "December": 85
}

# Calculate average
total = sum(rainfall.values())
average = total / len(rainfall)
print(f"Total: {total}")
print(f"Average: {average}")

# Find closest month
closest_month = min(rainfall.keys(), key=lambda m: abs(rainfall[m] - average))
print(f"Closest month: {closest_month} with value {rainfall[closest_month]}")
print(f"Difference: {abs(rainfall[closest_month] - average)}")

# Also show all differences for verification
for month, value in rainfall.items():
    diff = abs(value - average)
    print(f"{month}: {value}, diff: {diff:.2f}")
